name: Arcadia Management Area Free Primitive Trail Campsite - North-South Trail

management_agency.name: Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management (DEM) - Division of Forest Environment

rules_and_regulations.cost: 100% Free - Free RI DEM Backpacking Permit required online/office (zero fee)
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Primitive pack-in camping permitted only at designated primitive shelter/campsite locations along the North-South Trail within Arcadia Management Area. No vehicle camping inside interior.

waste_disposal_rules.poop_disposal: Cathole method: dig 6-8 inches deep in organic soil, at least 200 feet from Wood River and streams. Pack out toilet paper.
waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Strict Leave No Trace pack-it-in pack-it-out.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Gather dead and downed wood only.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Campfires in established rock fire rings only. Extinguish cold to touch.
campfire_rules.seasonal_fire_bans: Obey RI DEM Forest Environment burn bans.

access_and_road_conditions.road_type: Paved state road leading to gravel trailhead parking area (Ten Rod Road / Summit Road)
access_and_road_conditions.road_conditions: Paved state road access to trailhead lot. Campsites are a short 0.5 to 1.5 mile walk-in trail.
access_and_road_conditions.vehicle_recommendation: Normal low clearance front wheel drive car (parked at trailhead lot)

nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: Low (Gentle rolling white pine / oak forest)

amenities: Wood River Stream Water Access (Filter required)

seasonal_weather_effects.summer: 75-85°F, shaded white pine canopy, pleasant coastal summer climate.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Crisp 55-70°F days, brilliant New England autumn foliage, prime trail camping.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Cool 25-40°F, freezing nights, occasional light snow.

dangers_and_hazards: Blacklegged ticks (Lyme disease vector) in high brush

common_human_made_sounds: Distant aircraft approach for Providence Airport

human_demographics_and_culture: North-South Trail backpackers, trout anglers on Wood River, digital nomads, and local nature lovers.

spiritual_and_folklore_data.nature_spirits_and_mythological_lore: Narragansett and Niantic indigenous traditions revere the ancient pine forests and Wood River stream headwaters as sacred ancestral life lands.
spiritual_and_folklore_data.energetic_and_spiritual_features: White pine forest aroma and energy, serene stream acoustics, fast 5G connectivity.

nearby_hiking_trails.features: Winding white pine forest paths, Stepstone Falls, wooden footbridges

public_reviews_summary: Clean, quiet, and beautiful free primitive trail camping in Rhode Island. Blazing fast 5G cell internet and easy access.
other_data: Bortle Class 4 night sky. Free DEM permit required.
